note: V2 narration. Each 'group' is voiced in one pass (natural prosody across its sentences); 'say' is the spoken text (respelled names for clear pronunciation), 'cap' is the caption text. Group gaps are silence after the group.

groups.say: Why does doing good feel so hard?
groups.cap: Why does doing good feel so hard?

groups.say: Forty-one percent of Americans who didn't donate said they couldn't afford to.
groups.cap: 41% of Americans who didn't donate said they couldn't afford to.

groups.say: And almost half of adults say pressure to give puts them off.
groups.cap: And almost half of adults say pressure to give puts them off.

groups.say: What if kindness could grow differently?
groups.cap: What if kindness could grow differently?

groups.say: Meet Hug shire.
groups.cap: Meet Hugshire.

groups.say: A cozy little world where your savings can help real causes grow. And where helping means more than just giving money.
groups.cap: A cozy little world where your savings can help real causes grow. And where helping means more than just giving money.

groups.say: Plant your deposit.
groups.cap: Plant your deposit.

groups.say: Through the Hug shire Vault and Ree-uh Finance, your funds can earn variable lending yield.
groups.cap: Through the Hugshire Vault and RHEA Finance, your funds can earn variable lending yield.

groups.say: That yield grows as fruit on your Heart Tree.
groups.cap: That yield grows as fruit on your Heart Tree.

groups.say: Harvest it, choose a cause, and turn your earnings into kindness.
groups.cap: Harvest it, choose a cause, and turn your earnings into kindness.

groups.say: Explore a world of causes.
groups.cap: Explore a world of causes.

groups.say: Visit different towns, discover their stories, and find more communities to support.
groups.cap: Visit different towns, discover their stories, and find more communities to support.

groups.say: But Hug shire isn't just about giving.
groups.cap: But Hugshire isn't just about giving.

groups.say: You can be part of the community!
groups.cap: You can be part of the community!

groups.say: Play, contribute resources, and help build something together.
groups.cap: Play, contribute resources, and help build something together.

groups.say: And watch your little town grow, one contribution at a time.
groups.cap: And watch your little town grow, one contribution at a time.

groups.say: And there's another way to help.
groups.cap: And there's another way to help.

groups.say: Choose to watch an ad, and eligible ad revenue can support the Community Heart Pool.
groups.cap: Choose to watch an ad, and eligible ad revenue can support the Community Heart Pool.

groups.say: The shared charity budget is split equally among eligible supporters.
groups.cap: The shared charity budget is split equally among eligible supporters.

groups.say: And everyone chooses which approved cause their share supports.
groups.cap: And everyone chooses which approved cause their share supports.

groups.say: And as we build our little world together, we stay connected to the communities we're helping.
groups.cap: And as we build our little world together, we stay connected to the communities we're helping.

groups.say: Visit the Notice Board to follow their latest updates, see their stories, and discover the progress they're making beyond the game.
groups.cap: Visit the Notice Board to follow their latest updates, see their stories, and discover the progress they're making beyond the game.

groups.say: And your deposit stays yours to request back when you need it, subject to lending risks and withdrawal conditions.
groups.cap: And your deposit stays yours to request back when you need it, subject to lending risks and withdrawal conditions.

groups.say: Simple enough to feel like a game.
groups.cap: Simple enough to feel like a game.

groups.say: And designed so every payout to a cause can be verified on the Near blockchain.
groups.cap: And designed so every payout to a cause can be verified on the NEAR blockchain.

groups.say: More than giving.
groups.cap: More than giving.

groups.say: A world we grow together.
groups.cap: A world we grow together.

groups.say: Hug shire.
groups.cap: Hugshire.

groups.say: Where kindness takes shape.
groups.cap: Where kindness takes shape.
